content: Jesus, Pilate Ęhdaa Nigiiyąąhchįį

Vanh dąį' gwagwahkhan hee, giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį, ts'ą' Israel kįh dilk'ii nąįį, ts'ą' Law eech'ǫąąhtan nąįį, ts'ą' izhit kįh dilk'ii nąįį haa datthak deegihee'yaa nihłaa geegigiinkhii. Ąįįtł'ęę Jesus ch'iitsii tły'ah haa digiiyiłchaa ts'ą' gihłeegiihiłchįį ts'ą' Pilate ts'ą' nigiiyąąhchįį.
Pilate yuahkat, “Jews nąįį goo-king inlii?” Jesus jyaa yahnyąą, “Nan jyaa diinyąą t'iinyąą.”
Giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį, “Łyaa gwinlęįį gwiizųų gwitr'it t'agwah'ya' t'inchy'aa.” giiyahnyąą.
Ąįį geh'an Pilate, chan hee neeyuahkat, “Nik'ee gwidii giihinkhyaa? Łyaa gwinlęįį ninehts'į' giginkhii gwiintth'ak!” yahnyąą.
Chan hee Jesus, k'eegwiichy'aa t'inyąą kwaa, ts'ą' Pilate łyaa geegoolii kwaa.
Jesus Giiyęhdaa Tr'igwihee'aa Geenjit Shragwaazhit
Gweedhaa datthak nijin Passover ch'aga'aa gwagwahtsii dąį', Pilate, ąįį juu giindhan ch'ihłak gooveenjit zheh gwaazhrąįį chanahchik.
Zhat dąį' dinjii Barabbas zheh gwaazhrąįį dhidii zhit juu k'eedeegwaadhat nąįį ts'ą' nich'itsagahthat nąįį tee dhidii ts'ą', nich'itsagahthat gwiizhit gwitee dinjii ęhdaa tr'igwigwiin'ąįį.
Dinjii lęįį nąįį łagaajil ts'ą' ąįį zheh gwaazhrąįį gwats'an dinjii ch'ihłak chineehahchyaa ji' eenjit, Pilate goahkat.
“Jews nąįį eenjit King nilii, ąįį nakhweenjit chinoołchyaa shohnyąą?” gavahnyąą.
Ginkhih k'įh dilk'ii nąįį Jesus itr'igii'ee geh'an Pilate antł'eegiiyahchįį goovaandaii.
Giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį, zhit dinjii nąįį datthak Barabbas, Pilate chineeyahahchyaa eenjit jyaa dohnyąą googahnyąą.
Ts'ą' Pilate dinjii nąįį chan hee ts'ą' jyaa nyąą, “Ąįį ji' yagha' Jews eenjit King nilii vohnyąą ąįį deehihłyaa?”
Ąįį dinjii nąįį gazhral ts'ą' t'igiiyahnyąą, “Cross kat gohtsak!” giiyahnyąą.
“Jidii tr'agwaanduu tr'agwah'ya'?” nyąą ts'ą' Pilate gavahkat. Googaa nihk'it gwandaa gazhral ts'ą', “Cross kat garahahtsak ąhtsii!” giiyahnyąą.

Pilate zhat dinjii lęįį nąįį ts'ą' gwiinzii t'asho'ya' yiindhan geh'an Barabbas zhee gwaazhrąįį gwats'an chanaahchįį ąįįtł'ęę Jesus viitrii haa gahtrii gwiłtsąįį, ts'ą' cross kat garahahtsak eenjit gwantł'eeyahchįį.
Niveet'ah'in Nąįį Jesus Eegeedlaa.
Pilate viniveet'ah'in nąįį vizheh gweelin tthał needhe'ee ąįį zhit gwizhit nihdeegiiyąąhchįį ts'ą' niveet'ah'in nąįį datthak zhat khaihłan nigiinlii.
Ch'adak ik daatsik k'it t'inchy'aa giinaahtsųų, ąįįts'ą' chan khoh giiłtły'aa ąįį łihts'eenaat'aii tseh giiyiłtsąįį ts'ą' giiki' kat nigiiyin'ąįį.
“Jews nąįį goo-King niighyuk goondaii.” Ginyąą ts'ą' giiyeedlaa gwiizhit deegiihił'e' adagaa'įį.
Giiki' gał haa oahkhaa gwiizhit giikaahizhree ts'ą' giits'ą' nikiigwiitthak ts'ą' deegiiyihiił'e' k'it gwagwahtsii.
Nijin giiyeedlaa tł'ęę ąįį ik giinaahtsųų chy'aa, giineetr'aatsuu ts'ą' giigwach'aa ąįį giinineenlii ts'ą' cross kat gigiihahtsak gwats'ą' giiyeehiłchįį.
Jesus Giriłtsak
K'iidak geedaa gwiizhit, Simon goodaazhii akhai' niveet'ah'in nąįį, Jesus va-cross ichyaa giits'an gwiłtsąįį. (Simon, kwaiik'it Cyrene gwats'an ahaa ąįįts'ą' Alexander ts'ą' Rufus nąįį gooti' nilii.)
Golgotha goozhii ąįįt'ee “Dinjii kiitth'an deek'it.” gwinyąą t'igwinyąą, ąįį zhit gwats'ą' Jesus gihiłchįį.
Jak chų' vitee gwanzhįh chų' Myrrh giiyantł'eehahkaii gaa Jesus yeenii kwaa.
Ąįįtł'ęę cross kat gigiiyiłtsak ts'ą' giigwach'aa datthak, nihteegeelzhii, ts'ą' tth'an ghoo gahaanjal haa juu shrit jidii gwach'aa hoondal li' geenjit tseegii'in.
Vanh 9:00 nigwiindhat gwiizhit gigiiyiłtsak.
Vehdee dachan kat jidii eenjit gigiiyiłtsak ąįį dagwagwaantł'oo, “Jews nąįį goo-King nilii.”
Dinjii ch'an'įį neekwaii nąįį giiyaagiłtsak, dinjii ch'ihłak vishriits'ąįį, ts'ą' ch'izhii chan vatł'ohts'ąįį, jyąhts'ą' gaagoogiiłtsak.
Yeenaa dąį' Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit jyaa digweheenjyaa gwinyąą ts'ą' gwadanakhwatł'oo, ąįį łi'didlii haa gwik'it t'igwiizhik. “Dinjii Law łahnaii nąįį haa narąhchįį” gwinyąą.
Dinjii gehgoohijyaa nąįį digiki' gaathat gwiizhit Jesus ts'ą' gwiizųų giginkhii. “Aahą'! Kharigidiinjii Zheh shrahtee gwahaałtsyaa ts'ą' drin tik gwiizhit ndak nineegwihihtthal diinyąą ijii?
It'ee nihindhaa gwits'į' cross ts'an neenindii,” giiyahnyąą.

Jyaa ts'ą' gwik'it chan giinkhih kįh dilk'ii nąįį ts'ą' Law eech'ǫąąhtan nąįį haa jyaa nihłagaanyąą, giiyeedlaa ts'ą' t'iginyąą, “Ch'izhii dinjii nąįį neeheezhii ąhtsii, gwiizhit adan ąįį vęhdaa tr'igwirehee'aa gwits'į' gwats'an tr'eedahaachyaa.”
Christ ts'ą' Israel gwich'in nąįį goo-king inlii ji', cross ts'an nineedaanchįį ąįįtł'ęę nik'injireheedhaa!” giiyahnyąą. Ąįį juu neekwaii giiyaagiłtsak nąįį gaa gwiizųų giits'ą' ginkhii.
Jesus Niindhat
Drintł'an 12:00 nigwiindhat gwiizhit nankat datthak tǫǫ nagwaanąįį, ts'ą' 3 hrs. datthak tǫǫ gwin'e'.
3:00 gwa'an gweedhaa gwiizhit, Jesus gwint'aii khashraa'iintrat, “Eloi, Eloi, lama shabachthani!” ąįįt'ee, “Shivit'eegwijyąhchy'aa, Shivit'eegwijyąhchy'aa, jaghaii akhashoiinyąą?” gwinyąą t'igwinyąą.
Dinjii nąįį lat giiyiitth'ak ts'ą' jyaa ginyąą, “Ch'oodǫǫhk'įį Elijah keeginkhii t'inyąą!” giiyahnyąą.

Dinjii ch'ihłak yats'ą' hilgik ts'ą' sponge ahtsit ts'ą' jak chų' (wine) daatł'oo kwaa ąįį zhit tee yahtsuu ąįį gał tsii niyahtsuu ts'ą' yiheenjyaa geenjit yats'ą' yuuntą'. Gwiizhit dinjii nąįį ts'ą' jyaa nyąą, “Jyaa dohthan, nagwaroo'ya', Elijah neeheedyaa ts'ą' cross ts'an tr'ineeyahahchyaa ji' geenjit tr'agwahaah'yaa.” nyąą.
Jesus, gwintł'oo khashraa'iintrat, tł'ęę niindhat.
Ąįįtł'ęę Khadigiriinjii Zheh gwizhit gindeiinvyaa choh gwach'aa dach'at haa iltsąįį teetł'an dakhii gwats'an k'iizhak datthak nihtr'iinch'aa.
Nijin ąįį niveet'ah'in kįh dhidii, Cross ehzhee Jesus ts'ą' nadhat dąį' vandah Jesus niindhat nah'ya' jyaa nyąą, “Jii dinjii łyaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Vidinji' nilii łee!” nyąą.
Tr'injaa lat nąįį niighit nigiilzhii gwats'an aakin gwagwaa'įį, Mary Magdalene, ts'ą' tsyaa James ts'ą' Joseph haa goohan Mary, ts'ą' tr'injaa Salome chan gootee nigiilzhii.
Jesus, Galilee t'inchy'aa dąį' haa neegihiidal, ts'ą' giits'inya' tr'injaa lęįį nąįį Jerusalem gwats'ą' giiyahaajil nąįį chan zhat goovaa t'igiinchy'aa.
Jesus Vanarąąhjik

Khaa nigwiindhat ts'ą', Neegwaazhii Drin gwats'ą' drin gwanlii geh'an, Joseph, Aramathea kwaiik'it gwachoo gwats'an ahaa ts'ą' dinjii hil'ee nilii ts'ą' Jews k'eedeegwaadhat nąįį tee dhidii, ts'ą' adan t'ee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Veegwinii'ee geenjit nagool'in nilii ts'ą' naajat kwaa haa Pilate ts'ą' haazhii ts'ą' Jesus vichį' shantł'eerohchyaa nyąą ts'ą' ch'oahkat.

Nijin Jesus ch'adąį' hee niindhat giiyahnyąą dąį' Pilate łyaa geegwaroolii kwaa veenjit t'igwiizhit. Niveet'ah'in k'įh dhidii ch'ihłak aanaii ahnyąą ts'ą', Jesus juk niighyuk iłchįį ji' eenjit oahkat.
Nijin niveet'ah'in k'įh dhidii yaagwildak tł'ęę Pilate, Joseph t'ahnyąą, “Jesus vichį' oiinjii!” yahnyąą.

Ąįįtł'ęę Joseph, gwach'aa dril daagąįį oiinkwat ts'ą' Jesus vichį' cross ts'an nąhchįį ts'ą' gwach'aa dril zhit yahchįį. Kii zhit gweedii goo'aii gwizhit tth'ank'it gwagwaa'įį ąįį zhit gwizhit niyąąhchįį ts'ą' gwadąįį kiichyaa choh, gihdeiin'ąįį.
Mary Magdalene, ąįįts'ą' Joseph vahan Mary haa nijin giinąąhjik gwagwaah'in.
